candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  `/v1/audio/transcriptions` accepts OpenAI's `timestamp_granularities[]=word`, but no model returns `words`. The serving code never reads the field, and `verbose_json` works only for models whose decoder writes segment timestamps as tokens (Whisper, FunASR, FireRedASR2). Word timestamps are a common need for captions, search and editing (#39735 asks for them in `/v1/realtime`).  Many speech LLMs can produce word timestamps from the audio encoder.
